items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: The interviewer asks 'So Saiz, your first cousin.' The interviewee does not confirm this but instead corrects the interviewer regarding other people: 'Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes, also my first cousin.'

ctx.x: The Frazier's too. Yeah, I can explain you that. Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes' mother and my mother, two sisters. What was your mother's maiden name then? My mother's maiden name was, her maiden name was Frazier, Jeanette Frazier. Now, uh, the Frazier's, Josiah Frazier's name, their father and my mother were citizen brothers. Yeah, I see. Yeah.
So Saiz, your first cousin. First cousin.
Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes, also my first cousin.
